note: BOOT topic for live_demo --vocab250 (34 words). This is what DEFAULT_TOPIC names, and it is the general 'can I be understood at all' set -- hello, mom, dad, please, hungry, thirsty, water, sleep, sick. Restored 2026-09-10: it was deleted as 'superseded by the 11' topics WITHOUT updating DEFAULT_TOPIC, so --vocab250 booted into whatever sorted first (topic_actions, 24 action words) and a signer trying hello or water got nothing. That is the exact failure the comment above the boot-mask logic warns about, reintroduced by the commit that wrote the warning.
why_this_one_boots: Highest-accuracy general set available: mean per-word held-out accuracy 0.8845 against 0.8241 for the union of the 11 coverage topics and 0.7571 for all 250. Nothing in it is below the 0.60 floor (min 0.6429). The 11 topics exist for COVERAGE -- every word reachable by pressing T. This one exists to be the state the demo opens in.
mass_min_why: PROVISIONAL, not measured. Out-of-topic rejection: refuse a sign unless at least this much of the model's UNMASKED probability lands on these words. Without it a narrow mask MUST name one of its own words, so an out-of-topic sign is spoken as a WRONG one -- measured at 13.6-20.3% on the 123-class medical model. 0.10 is the class-count scaling of the 0.20 that measured free there (a diffuse prediction puts ~34/250 here against ~34/123 on medical, so the same number is materially stricter). docs/KAGGLE_250_TOPIC_EVAL.md measures it.

measured_per_word.source: word_acc_250.json — per-word held-out test accuracy, fold 0 of the LEGACY model
measured_per_word.caveat_on_the_model: this is fold-0 of artifacts_250 (LEGACY, 0.7576). The demo should run artifacts_250_canonical, which supersedes it (0.7787 @30fps / 0.7628 @7fps) -- so these per-word figures understate the shipped configuration rather than flattering it.

caveat: UNMEASURED GATE NUMBERS. mean/min_test_acc are real. first_try, precision, off-topic false speech and mass_min are NOT measured for this model -- there is no held-out test SET in the repo, only the per-word exemplar clips, which are training data and report precision 1.000 at every threshold. Do not quote a first-try rate for --vocab250 until docs/KAGGLE_250_TOPIC_EVAL.md has run.
